quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah preferred Adam and Noah and the Family of Abraham and the Family of 'Imran above (all His) creatures.

explanation.bs: „Allah je, zaista, odabrao Adema i Nuha…“ – odabir vjerovjesnika i porodica.
explanation.en: “Lo! Allah preferred [chose] Adam and Noah…” — the choosing of prophets and families.

quranTranslation.text: And when the angels said: O Mary! Lo! Allah hath chosen thee and made thee pure, and hath preferred thee above (all) the women of creation.

explanation.bs: „O Merjema, tebe je Allah odabrao i očistio te, i nad ženama svih svjetova te odabrao“ – dvostruki odabir.
explanation.en: “O Mary! Lo! Allah hath chosen thee and made thee pure, and hath preferred [chosen] thee above (all) the women of creation” — a twofold choosing.

quranTranslation.text: Allah chooseth from the angels messengers, and (also) from mankind. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Seer.

explanation.bs: „Allah odabire poslanike iz reda meleka, i iz reda ljudi“ – odabir za poslanstvo.
explanation.en: “Allah chooseth from the angels messengers, and (also) from mankind” — choosing for the message.

quranTranslation.text: Then his Lord chose him, and relented toward him, and guided him.

explanation.bs: „Zatim ga je Gospodar njegov odabrao, primio mu pokajanje i uputio ga“ – Adem nakon posrnuća.
explanation.en: “Then his Lord chose him, and relented toward him, and guided him” — Adam after his slip.

quranTranslation.text: But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous.

explanation.bs: „Pa ga je Gospodar njegov odabrao i učinio ga jednim od dobrih“ – Junus.
explanation.en: “But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous” — Jonah.

quranTranslation.text: Thankful for His bounties; He chose him and He guided him unto a straight path.

explanation.bs: „…odabrao ga je i uputio na pravi put“ – Ibrahim.
explanation.en: “He chose him and He guided him unto a straight path” — Abraham.

quranTranslation.text: And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired.

explanation.bs: „A Ja sam te izabrao, pa slušaj ono što se objavljuje“ – Allah bira Musu.
explanation.en: “And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired” — Allah chooses Moses.

quranTranslation.text: And Moses chose of his people seventy men for Our appointed tryst and, when the trembling came on them, he said: My Lord! If Thou hadst willed Thou hadst destroyed them long before, and me with them. Wilt thou destroy us for that which the ignorant among us did? It is but Thy trial (of us). Thou sendest whom Thou wilt astray and guidest whom Thou wilt: Thou art our Protecting Friend, therefore forgive us and have mercy on us, Thou, the Best of all who show forgiveness.

explanation.bs: „I Musa je iz svog naroda izabrao sedamdeset ljudi“ – čovjek koji bira.
explanation.en: “And Moses chose of his people seventy men” — a man who chooses.

quranTranslation.text: And when We said: Go into this township and eat freely of that which is therein, and enter the gate prostrate, and say: "Repentance." We will forgive you your sins and will increase (reward) for the right-doers.

explanation.bs: „Uđite u ovo naselje“ – ulazak u mjesto.
explanation.en: “Go into this township” — entering a place.

quranTranslation.text: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,

explanation.bs: „…i vidiš ljude kako u skupinama ulaze u Allahovu vjeru“ – ulazak u vjeru.
explanation.en: “And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops” — entering a religion.

quranTranslation.text: (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure.

explanation.bs: „Uđite u njih s mirom, sigurni!“ – ulazak u Džennet.
explanation.en: “Enter them in peace, secure” — entering Paradise.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! they who deny Our revelations and scorn them, for them the gates of heaven will nor be opened not will they enter the Garden until the camel goeth through the needle's eye. Thus do We requite the guilty.

explanation.bs: „…i neće ući u Džennet dok se deva ne provuče kroz iglene uši“ – دَخَلَ i وَلَجَ u istom ajetu: ulazak naspram provlačenja.
explanation.en: “…will they enter the Garden until the camel goeth through the needle's eye” — دَخَلَ and وَلَجَ in one ayah: entering against passing through.

quranTranslation.text: He knoweth that which goeth into the earth and that which cometh forth from it, and that descendeth from the heaven and that which ascendeth into it. He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.

explanation.bs: „Zna šta prodire u zemlju i šta iz nje izlazi“ – prodiranje u zemlju (mufesiri: kiša, sjeme, mrtvi).
explanation.en: “He knoweth that which goeth into the earth and that which cometh forth from it” — going into the earth (mufassirun: rain, seeds, the dead).

quranTranslation.text: Go, both of you, unto Pharaoh. Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).

explanation.bs: Musau i Harunu: „Otiđite vas dvojica faraonu, on se, zaista, osilio.“
explanation.en: To Moses and Aaron: “Go, both of you, unto Pharaoh. Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).”

quranTranslation.text: And when the awe departed from Abraham, and the glad news reached him, he pleaded with Us on behalf of the folk of Lot.

explanation.bs: „Pa kad je strepnja otišla od Ibrahima …“ – nestaje nešto što nije tijelo; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And when the awe departed from Abraham …” — what goes away is no body; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Their likeness is as the likeness of one who kindleth fire, and when it sheddeth its light around him Allah taketh away their light and leaveth them in darkness, where they cannot see,

explanation.bs: „… Allah im odnese svjetlo“ – ذَهَبَ بِـ: odnijeti; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… Allah taketh away their light” — ذَهَبَ بِـ: to take away; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Then We destroyed men mightier than these in prowess; and the example of the men of old hath gone (before them).

explanation.bs: „… a primjer onih prijašnjih već je prošao“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… and the example of the men of old hath gone (before them)” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to pass on, to go on

quranTranslation.text: Tell those who disbelieve that if they cease (from persecution of believers) that which is past will be forgiven them; but if they return (thereto) then the example of the men of old hath already gone (before them, for a warning).

explanation.bs: „… a ako se vrate – već je prošao postupak s ranijim narodima“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… but if they return (thereto) then the example of the men of old hath already gone” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to pass on, to go on

quranTranslation.text: So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded.

explanation.bs: Lutu: „… i niko od vas neka se ne okreće, a vi idite dalje onamo kamo vam se zapovijeda.“
explanation.en: To Lot: “… Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded.”

gloss.en: to pass on, to go on

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers.

explanation.bs: „O vjernici, neka jedni ljudi ne ismijavaju druge – možda su bolji od njih …“ – ismijavanje ljudi, zabranjeno među vjernicima.
explanation.en: “O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are)” — ridicule of people, forbidden among believers.

quranTranslation.text: And he was building the ship, and every time that chieftains of his people passed him, they made mock of him. He said: Though ye make mock of Us, yet We mock at you even as ye mock;

explanation.bs: Glavešine Nuhova naroda ismijavaju ga dok gradi lađu, a on im odgovara da će im se isto vratiti – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: The chiefs of Noah's people ridicule him as he builds the ship, and he answers that the same will come back to them — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Those who point at such of the believers as give the alms willingly and such as can find naught to give but their endeavours, and deride them - Allah (Himself) derideth them. Theirs will be a painful doom.

explanation.bs: „… pa ih ismijavaju – Allah njih ismijava …“ – kod Allaha to je uzvrat, kako Njemu priliči, kako ar-Rāġib tumači.
explanation.en: “… and deride them - Allah (Himself) derideth them” — from Allah it is requital, as befits Him, as ar-Rāġib explains.

quranTranslation.text: And if thou ask them (O Muhammad) they will say: We did but talk and jest. Say: Was it at Allah and His revelations and His messenger that ye did scoff?

explanation.bs: „… Reci: ‚Zar ste se Allahu, Njegovim ajetima i Njegovom Poslaniku izrugivali?‘“ – oni su to nazvali ‚pričom i igrom‘; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Say: Was it at Allah and His revelations and His messenger that ye did scoff?” — they had called it ‘talk and jest’; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to scoff, to make a jest of

quranTranslation.text: Messengers (of Allah) have been derided before thee, but that whereat they scoffed surrounded such of them as did deride.

explanation.bs: „… pa je one koji su ih ismijavali stiglo ono čemu su se izrugivali“ – oba glagola u jednom ajetu: سَخِرُوا za ljude koji su to činili, يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ za ono s čim su zbijali sprdnju.
explanation.en: “… that whereat they scoffed surrounded such of them as did deride” — both verbs in one ayah: سَخِرُوا of the people who did it, يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ of what they made a jest of.

gloss.en: to scoff, to make a jest of

quranTranslation.text: Allah (Himself) doth mock them, leaving them to wander blindly on in their contumacy.

explanation.bs: Allah im uzvraća za izrugivanje i ostavlja ih da slijepo lutaju u svojoj obijesti – ar-Rāġib: uzvrat za izrugivanje, kako Njemu priliči; dao im je vremena, pa ih iznenada zahvatio.
explanation.en: Allah requites their scoffing and leaves them to wander in their transgression — ar-Rāġib: the requital of scoffing, as befits Him; He gave them respite, then seized them unawares.

gloss.en: to scoff, to make a jest of

quranTranslation.text: Warfare is ordained for you, though it is hateful unto you; but it may happen that ye hate a thing which is good for you, and it may happen that ye love a thing which is bad for you. Allah knoweth, ye know not.

explanation.bs: „Propisana vam je borba, iako vam je mrska …“ – borba kao propis.
explanation.en: Fighting (al-qitāl) “is ordained for you, though it is hateful unto you” — fighting as an ordinance.

quranTranslation.text: Bethink thee of the leaders of the Children of Israel after Moses, how they said unto a prophet whom they had: Set up for us a king and we will fight in Allah's way. He said: Would ye then refrain from fighting if fighting were prescribed for you? They said: Why should we not fight in Allah's way when we have been driven from our dwellings with our children? Yet, when fighting was prescribed for them, they turned away, all save a few of them. Allah is aware of evil-doers.

explanation.bs: „… ‚Da se možda nećete boriti ako vam borba bude propisana?‘ …“ i: „A kad im je borba propisana, okrenuše se, osim malo njih“ – sinovi Israilovi nakon Musaa.
explanation.en: “Would ye then refrain from fighting if fighting were prescribed for you?” and: “Yet, when fighting was prescribed for them, they turned away, all save a few of them” — the Children of Israel after Moses.

quranTranslation.text: And Allah repulsed the disbelievers in their wrath; they gained no good. Allah averted their attack from the believers. Allah is ever Strong, Mighty.

explanation.bs: „… a Allah je vjernike poštedio borbe …“ – borba koja nije morala biti.
explanation.en: Allah spared the believers the fighting — a fight that did not have to come.

quranTranslation.text: The Jews say: Allah's hand is fettered. Their hands are fettered and they are accursed for saying so. Nay, but both His hands are spread out wide in bounty. He bestoweth as He will. That which hath been revealed unto thee from thy Lord is certain to increase the contumacy and disbelief of many of them, and We have cast among them enmity and hatred till the Day of Resurrection. As often as they light a fire for war, Allah extinguisheth it. Their effort is for corruption in the land, and Allah loveth not corrupters.

explanation.bs: „Kad god potpale vatru za rat, Allah je ugasi …“ – rat kao vatra koja se pali i gasi.
explanation.en: “As often as they light a fire for war, Allah extinguisheth it” — war as a fire lit and put out.

quranTranslation.text: Now when ye meet in battle those who disbelieve, then it is smiting of the necks until, when ye have routed them, then making fast of bonds; and afterward either grace or ransom till the war lay down its burdens. That (is the ordinance). And if Allah willed He could have punished them (without you) but (thus it is ordained) that He may try some of you by means of others. And those who are slain in the way of Allah, He rendereth not their actions vain.

explanation.bs: „… sve dok rat ne odloži svoje terete“ – rat kao stanje koje traje dok ne završi.
explanation.en: “till the war lay down its burdens” — war as a state that lasts until it ends.

quranTranslation.text: And if ye do not, then be warned of war (against you) from Allah and His messenger. And if ye repent, then ye have your principal (without interest). Wrong not, and ye shall not be wronged.

explanation.bs: „A ako to ne učinite, onda znajte da vam je navješten rat od Allaha i Njegova Poslanika …“ – opomena onima koji ustraju u kamati.
explanation.en: “And if ye do not, then be warned of war (against you) from Allah and His messenger” — a warning to those who persist in usury.
